content.short: CryptoZombies is an interactive Web3 school focused on Ethereum and Solidity development.
content.description: CryptoZombies is an interactive Web3 school that centers on Ethereum and Solidity development. Its courses teach learners to write smart contracts by building their own crypto-collectibles game. The program emphasizes hands-on practice through practical coding challenges and game-building projects. The team is exploring expansion to other chains, such as Binance Smart Chain and TRON, and incorporating projects like Chainlink, broadening content beyond Ethereum while maintaining focus on core Web3 skills.
